direction_notes: Without microbubbles, ultrasound evoked contralateral forelimb EMG responses with success rate rising with pressure. The paper's SonoVue arms are not recorded (E4, worked example Liu 2023).

target.label: right M1 region / mouse motor cortex

timing.protocol_description: 400 ms stimulation, 3.6 s interstimulus interval, 1000 Hz PRF, 40 % DC; tested with and without a single 60 ul tail-vein injection of SonoVue microbubbles; pressure P0 varied from 0.17 to 0.58 MPa.

exposures.label: Temporal interference tFUS, 1 + 0.8 MHz, without microbubbles

target.label: right M1 region / mouse motor cortex

timing.protocol_description: Two-frequency temporal interference (1 + 0.8 MHz) with the same 400 ms stimulation, 3.6 s interval, 1000 Hz PRF and 40 % DC; with and without microbubbles.

flags.reason: Peak pressures 0.17, 0.25, 0.33, 0.58 MPa are described as measured at the focus posterior to the skull while the field was characterised in degassed water; domain unclear. The quote contains only 0.33 and 0.58.
40 % DC is stated in the Results, not in the Methods parameter list; pulse duration not stated, left not_reported.
TI combines 1 and 0.8 MHz (0.81 MHz in the simulation table); recorded as a list.
Number of mice is not stated in the text.
Microbubbles were injected in some arms; under INCLUSION.md E4 (any arm given with microbubbles) this paper may be out of scope.
Transducer maker not named; only a 1 MHz focused transducer with 20 mm aperture is described.
